title: Developer Mode
description: Best modpack for developers including designers, content creators and map makers.
body:
![Developer mode logo](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/1eac9512395dc1162ce79c6f37c8b96771073512.png)

### Description
**All in-one solution for server, mod, resource pack and shader developers, content creators and map-mackers to solve their problem with collecting mods from sources, or installing them one-by one(time wasting). This modpack saves a lot of time, and includes avaerything you need (shaders, resource packs, building, developing, recording and much more mods...)**

### Features
- In-game menu editor
- ReplayMod for recording the game
- Screenshot viewer and taker
- Axiom and Effortless structure for detalized building
- Better visualized and detalized F3 menu
- Distant Horizons for more chunk loading
- NPC mod for designing thumbnails and graphic arts



### Support
**Inform us through Discord or Telegram about any bugs, or to give us your ideas to improve our pack.**
